sources.entry: Claude Code: Everything You Need to Know by wesammustafa - A conceptual, mental-models-first primer that explains what Claude Code is and how its agentic loop works, then layers setup, prompt-engineering workflows, skills, hooks, MCP, subagents, and agent teams, with an experience-tiered path for newcomers.

summary.one_liner: A community learning guide to Claude Code, organized as three levels (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced) and taught through a terminal learning app and practice-copy exercises.
summary.what_it_does: The repository is a structured course on Claude Code that starts with conceptual mental models and then covers setup, permission modes and plan mode, prompt-driven workflows, skills, hooks, subagents, MCP, plugins, and agent teams. Each core lesson ends with a check run from a practice copy (for example `npm run check -- b-1`) that prints PASS or FAIL with hints. An `npm run learn` terminal app walks through lessons step by step, with help that fades from GUIDED to HINTED to CHALLENGE. The README lists Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced paths with lessons, capstones and electives, plus reference pages, a glossary, and examples meant to be copied into projects. It states that the app uses no AI and changes none of the user's work. The guide is described as an independent community project, not affiliated with Anthropic.
use_cases: learning Claude Code step by step
onboarding a team to Claude Code
practicing skills, hooks and subagents safely
setting up project memory with CLAUDE.md
running Claude Code in CI or scripts with claude -p
how_to_run: Create a practice copy of the claude-code-practice template via 'Use this template' on GitHub, then clone it
Open a second terminal in the same folder and follow the app's instructions to install Claude Code
npm run check -- b-1 (example check command from a lesson)
notable: Three-level path (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced) with capstones and electives
Practice-copy exercises with automated PASS/FAIL checks after each core lesson
Terminal learning app with help that fades as skills improve
Lessons stamped with the Claude Code stable version they were checked against
Scheduled CI and link checks to keep content current
caveats: Requires a paid Claude plan (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise), a Claude Console account, or a supported cloud provider
Needs Node.js LTS and git installed
Independent community guide, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic; content tied to a specific stable version and may go stale between editions
